events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV changed the game. Remember the first time you saw a music video?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. Still sounds as fresh and rebellious as ever. What's your top track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, on Max Yasgur's farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. A moment that truly defined a generation.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy continue to inspire.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tribute to Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the enduring impact of Tupac Shakur. His voice and lyrics still resonate decades on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, one of the most influential guitarists in history, passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us ‘Abbey Road’. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders! Still rocking just as hard.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Britpop Legend
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic song 'Imagine' as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon’s 'Imagine' was released. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? Twenty-five years ago, it changed how we listened to music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and which theme song gets you shaken, not stirred?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that still sparks debate among fans. What's your favourite track?
